build.worktree_changes: tools/capture-build.patch (capture-only: lets the iOS Simulator build expose the loopback MCP automation listener; no rendering, HUD or simulation change)
build.ios: iOS Simulator release build (platforms/mobile/ios.py build --environment simulator --release), portable SDL renderer
build.host: macOS desktop release build of the same commit (tools/dev_build.py release=1), SDL dummy video driver, game software renderer, --interface touch --ui-scale <density>
build.android_emulator: Android release APK 0.11.8.1 from origin/master commit a9f878b9ff61 (platforms/mobile/android.py build --arch arm64-v8a --release, then sign with the local developer key), plus tools/capture-build.patch (capture-only MCP listener; no rendering, HUD or simulation change), run in the pinned Android emulator (platforms/mobile/emulator.json: emulator 37.1.11, Android 15 API 35 arm64-v8a default image) with host GPU rendering (-gpu host)

hd_artwork: HD artwork was active in every file. Files marked 'on (highResolutionArtworkChoice=on ...)' were captured with the setting forced on in the capture profile, so the session step-down that turns Auto HD artwork off after frame hitches or memory pressure could not apply. Files marked 'on (Auto ...)' are iOS Simulator frames from sessions whose simulator log was checked: the device profile resolved Auto to HD and no step-down event was logged.
